failure_condition: A dynamically updated status message is not exposed with status/live-region semantics.
interaction_steps: Capture the updated message and computed role.
expected_outcome: The control exposes the dynamic message as a status message.
manual_verification_method: Use a screen reader to verify announcement behavior; this is separate from semantic tree inspection.
dom_testability: Can inspect role/aria-live attributes and observe the message update.
accessibility_tree_testability: Can inspect computed status semantics after the update.
limitations: Neither a static DOM snapshot nor an AX tree snapshot proves that a screen reader announced the update.
